messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick Q — Kevin's team has an IC (Devon) approved for a level change effective 4/1. Kevin asked if the comp change can align with the payroll cycle on 4/15 or if we should do pro-rated backpay to 4/1.
kevin-engmgr: Ideally want the increase on 4/1 so recruiting offers and internal comp match. Any blockers to backdating to 4/1?
devon-ic: Also curious if this affects my stock vesting schedule or start-of-new-band probation period.
maria-peopleops: Short version: we can do either. Two paths — 1) effective 4/1 with backpay (requires paperwork + payroll cutoff) or 2) effective 4/15 with no retro. Backpay involves approvals and timing.
kevin-engmgr: What approvals? I already have the manager+director signoff and the compensation packet.
tara-peopleops: You still need final HR signoff + compensation change form in Workday. If you want retro to 4/1, submit the completed change form + evidence (manager approval email + leveling rubric excerpt) to hr-escalations and cc payroll. Leave a note in the form: "retro pay requested — effective 4/1".
kevin-engmgr: Any hard payroll cutoff dates I should be aware of?
payroll-bot: Payroll window reminder: changes must be in Workday and marked approved by the 10th of the month to affect the 15th payroll run. Retro requests after cutoff go to the next cycle and may require manual journal entries.
maria-peopleops: Exactly. For a 4/1 effective with backpay to hit 4/15, we need the signed packet in by Apr 10. If you miss that, it will likely land on 5/15 and backpay will cover 4/1–4/30.
devon-ic: Got it. How is backpay calculated for hourly vs salary? I'm salary.
maria-peopleops: For salaried folks we pro-rate on a daily basis based on annualized new salary vs old salary for the retro period. For hourly contractors we do a per-hour adjust (doesn't apply here).
kevin-engmgr: Does level change trigger a new equity grant or change vesting?
tara-peopleops: Level promotions don't automatically create new equity. If compables include an equity refresh, that's packaged separately and has its own approval + grant date. Vesting schedule doesn't reset unless a new grant is issued; original grant terms remain.
devon-ic: Are there any probation/check-in expectations when the level changes?
maria-peopleops: Policy: managers should run a 30/60 check-in cadence for promotions into a new band. No formal probation, but add the check-ins to the manager checklist and record outcomes in the growth doc.
kevin-engmgr: OK — last logistics Q: I have one hire-in-flight moving teams. If their comp change crosses orgs, do we need coordinated payroll entries?
tara-peopleops: Yes — moves across cost centers need both orgs to approve the change in Workday and payroll to get a single consolidated change. Please route via hr-escalations with both manager approvals and indicate the cost center transfer date.
kevin-engmgr: Thanks — I'll aim to file for 4/1 and get approvals before the 10th.
maria-peopleops: Perfect. Checklist: 1) attach manager approval email 2) attach leveling rubric excerpt or calibration note 3) fill comp change form in Workday, select "retro pay" if applicable 4) CC hr-escalations + payroll 5) schedule 30/60 check-ins. Ping me if anything blocks.
kevin-engmgr: Will do. One last thing — sample wording for the change note?
maria-peopleops: Use: "Approved level change to L4 effective 2026-04-01. Retro pay requested for period 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-14. Attached: manager approval email and calibration note. Payroll: please process retro in the 2026-04-15 payroll run if possible; if not, process in 2026-05-15 and notify manager." 
kevin-engmgr: Thanks :tada:
devon-ic: Appreciate it!
payroll-bot: Reminder: file attachments should be PDF. Non-PDFs delay processing.)
